# Theming & Customization

## Product themes (Primary / FidoAlert)

**Layer 1a — Product themes** swap tokens via CSS. The default `theme.css` is the **Primary** theme.

- **Primary** — default tokens (spacing, Primary palettes)
- **FidoAlert** (`fido-alert.css`) — roomier spacing plus FidoAlert brand palettes (primary red, secondary blue, etc.)

Semantic colors cascade through `var()` from the updated primitives.

```css
@import "@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens/theme.css";
@import "@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens/themes/fido-alert.css";
```

```html
<html data-fido-ui-theme="fidoAlert">
```

Storybook: use the **Theme** toolbar to preview each product theme.

## Overriding Component Styles

Every component accepts a `className` prop. FidoUI uses [Tailwind Merge](https://github.com/dcastil/tailwind-merge) internally, so your classes correctly override the defaults:

```tsx
<Button color="primary" shade="dark" className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700">
  Custom Purple
</Button>

<Badge color="success" shade="light" className="px-4 py-1">
  Bigger Badge
</Badge>
```

## Using Variant Functions Directly

Use the variant functions for custom elements that follow the design system:

```tsx
import { buttonVariants } from '@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/button';

// Style a link as a button
<a href="/signup" className={buttonVariants({ color: 'primary', shade: 'dark' })}>
  Sign Up
</a>
```

## Dark Mode

Override token values for dark mode using CSS class or data attribute:

```css
.dark, [data-theme="dark"] {
  --color-fido-ui-primary-500: #6b94fc;
  --color-fido-ui-primary-600: #4774fa;
  --color-fido-ui-neutral-white: #0a0a0a;
  --color-fido-ui-neutral-black: #ffffff;
}
```

Works with Tailwind's `dark:` variant automatically.

## Custom Theme

Override any design token by loading your CSS after the FidoUI theme:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens/theme.css";

/* Your overrides */
@theme {
  --color-fido-ui-primary-500: #8b5cf6;
  --radius-fido-ui-md: 12px;
}
```
